answer_1.quote: To test a model, an input sentence without diacritics is given to the model, and its output is compared with a reference text that is fully diacritized.
answer_1.outputs: Diacritized Arabic text (with short vowels and case endings)

answer_2.quote: We calculated the Word Error Rate (WER), which represents the percentage of words with at least one diacritic mistake, and the Diacritic Error Rate (DER), which represents the percentage of characters with a diacritic mistake.
